value.rationale: Global minimal log discrepancy is an intrinsic birational invariant centrally used in volume boundedness. Prior sources quantify a chosen marked log-Fano pair but do not give the actual singularity threshold of the underlying Fano varieties. The exact all-parameter value and unique minimizing center determine their intrinsic singularity severity and permit a sharp volume/mld normalization with leading constant one. The computation is motivated by the source’s sharpness examples, not an arbitrary slice.
